sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:161

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:161:1
items.html: And the Shema upon the bed, we must make it anew, and the Shema of the evening prayer does not suffice: Meaning, that we need to draw the coupling of the first intercourse to make her a vessel anew. And the Shema of the evening prayer does not avail here, for all the Mochin have already departed entirely in the blessing “He who casts,” and they have returned to their Katnut of the NR [Nefesh-Ruach] of nursing, as above.
